basic_profile.bio: I'm a language enthusiast in my late 20s, currently living in Wellington, New Zealand. I'm passionate about learning new languages and exploring diverse cultures. By day, I work as a digital marketing consultant, helping small businesses ramp up their online presence. In my free time, I enjoy collecting boutique Blu-rays and playing strategy games, particularly those involving complex narratives. I'm currently single and typically active on Reddit during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Linguistics and have self-taught myself several languages over the years. My expertise comes from both formal education and practical application, as I've traveled extensively and immersed myself in different cultures.
